فَطَأٌ [mentioned above as inf. n. of فَطِئَ, and in the O erroneously written فُطَاء,] i. q. فَطَسٌ [i. e. A depression and expansion of the bone of the nose; or a spreading of the nose upon the face]; (S, * O, * K;) and ↓ فَطَأَةٌ is syn. with فَطَسَةٌ [which is a subst. signifying as above] (S, O: but in one of my copies of the S, the former of these words is written فَطْأَة; and in the O, the latter is written فَطْسَة.) ―
-b2- And Hollowness of the back, (K, TA,) or, as some say, of the middle of the back, (TA,) and protuberance of the breast, or chest; as also ↓ فَطْأَةٌ . (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
